import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int S = 128;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class FieldMod {
        long v;

        FieldMod(long x) {
            v = x % MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
        }

        FieldMod add(FieldMod o) {
            long res = v + o.v;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new FieldMod(res);
        }

        FieldMod sub(FieldMod o) {
            long res = v - o.v;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new FieldMod(res);
        }

        FieldMod mul(FieldMod o) {
            return new FieldMod((v * o.v) % MOD);
        }

        FieldMod div(FieldMod o) {
            return mul(o.inv());
        }

        FieldMod inv() {
            return pow(MOD - 2);
        }

        FieldMod pow(int p) {
            long res = 1;
            long base = v;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
                base = (base * base) % MOD;
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return new FieldMod(res);
        }

        FieldMod neg() {
            if (v == 0) return new FieldMod(0);
            return new FieldMod(MOD - v);
        }

        FieldMod inc() {
            v++;
            if (v == MOD) v = 0;
            return this;
        }

        FieldMod dec() {
            v--;
            if (v == -1) v = MOD - 1;
            return this;
        }

        boolean eq(FieldMod o) {
            return v == o.v;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(v);
        }
    }

    static class Bitset implements Comparable<Bitset> {
        long[] data;
        int size;

        Bitset(int n) {
            size = n;
            data = new long[(n + 63) / 64];
        }

        void set(int i) {
            data[i / 64] |= (1L << (i % 64));
        }

        boolean get(int i) {
            return (data[i / 64] & (1L << (i % 64))) != 0;
        }

        boolean any() {
            for (long x : data) {
                if (x != 0) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        void or(Bitset other) {
            for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                data[i] |= other.data[i];
            }
        }

        void clear() {
            Arrays.fill(data, 0);
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Bitset other) {
            for (int i = size - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                boolean thisBit = get(i);
                boolean otherBit = other.get(i);
                if (thisBit != otherBit) {
                    return otherBit ? 1 : -1;
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (!(o instanceof Bitset)) return false;
            Bitset other = (Bitset) o;
            return compareTo(other) == 0;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            int hash = 0;
            for (long x : data) {
                hash = 31 * hash + (int) (x ^ (x >>> 32));
            }
            return hash;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        solve(br, pw);
        pw.close();
    }

    static void solve(BufferedReader br, PrintWriter pw) throws IOException {
        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        int[][] P = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
            }
        }

        Map<Bitset, FieldMod> G = new HashMap<>();
        Bitset init = new Bitset(S);
        init.set(0);
        G.put(init, new FieldMod(1));

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Map<List<Integer>, FieldMod> H = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Bitset, FieldMod> entry : G.entrySet()) {
                Bitset g = entry.getKey();
                List<Integer> S = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int m = 0; m < (1 << N); m++) {
                    if (g.get(m)) S.add(m);
                }
                H.put(S, entry.getValue());
            }

            G.clear();
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                FieldMod pst = new FieldMod(1);
                for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                    if ((j & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                        pst = pst.mul(new FieldMod(P[i][k]));
                    } else {
                        pst = pst.mul(new FieldMod(100 - P[i][k]));
                    }
                }

                for (Map.Entry<List<Integer>, FieldMod> entry : H.entrySet()) {
                    List<Integer> hList = entry.getKey();
                    Bitset ans = new Bitset(S);
                    for (int l = 0; l < N; l++) {
                        if ((j & (1 << l)) == 0) continue;
                        for (int m : hList) {
                            if ((m & (1 << l)) == 0) {
                                ans.set(m | (1 << l));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (ans.any()) {
                        FieldMod val = G.getOrDefault(ans, new FieldMod(0));
                        val = val.add(entry.getValue().mul(pst));
                        G.put(ans, val);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        FieldMod ans = new FieldMod(0);
        for (FieldMod val : G.values()) {
            ans = ans.add(val);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            ans = ans.div(new FieldMod(100));
        }

        pw.println(ans);
    }
}
